prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>: a Chinese man about 26 years old with a lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, a clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features, wearing a plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned dark blue-gray casual overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers. Here he wears a simple black commuting backpack.

summary:
[reference generation] At night, <Subject 1> pushes open the glass door of a clean modern convenience store and walks past the shelves toward the drinks refrigerator.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, natural short black hair, straight dark eyebrows, lean build, plain gray T-shirt, unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt, black trousers and white sneakers are retained, with the black backpack added.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture and soft highlight roll-off. The store is lit with clean cool-white light, with crisp silver-blue highlights on glass and metal.
[Shot 1] A medium shot from inside a clean, modern convenience store at night, looking toward the glass entrance doors at the left of the frame. Outside the doors, the street is dark blue, with blurred car lights passing. Cool-white light from the store spills through the glass onto the pavement. Neat white shelves of snacks, bottles and boxes line the aisle in the foreground and on the right, their packaging softly out of focus. <Subject 1>, his simple black commuting backpack on both shoulders over his unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt and plain gray T-shirt, pushes the glass door open with his right hand and steps inside. His face is clearly visible: a natural, composed after-work expression, calm, slightly tired, not sad. A soft electronic entrance chime sounds as the door opens. The door swings closed behind him. He walks into the store along the aisle at an ordinary pace, past the neat shelves, heading toward the glowing drinks refrigerators at the back of the store on the right. The camera tracks with him from the side with small amplitude at slow speed, keeping him at the same size in the frame, his face in three-quarter profile. The clean floor tiles reflect the ceiling lights. The store is quiet, with no other customers. All packaging, price labels and signs are softly out of focus, and there is no readable text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: A soft electronic entrance chime rings once as the door opens, the glass door swings closed with a gentle thud, his footsteps tap lightly on the tiled floor, and a quiet refrigeration hum fills the store.

non_diegetic_music: Ambient electronic music at a slow tempo: sustained synth pads and a soft, steady low pulse, joined by light, bright electronic plucks, kept low in volume.
